recognition_text: The drum that births the Sanskrit alphabet sounds in your Venus-Dhanishta placement
Mars in Shatabhisha wields the healer's blade — protection through precision
Jupiter in Anuradha — Mitra's covenant guides the wayward mind home
Your Rohini lagna births from the lotus — Brahma's seat is your rising sign
Exalted Saturn in Swati — Varuna's conch sounds through disciplined independence
Ketu in Mula dissolves — the trident parts what must be parted
Moon in Punarvasu returns to Aditi — Saraswati's veena plays the eternal return
Sun in Shravana hears — Vishnu's discus cuts through ignorance at the speed of listening
